$comment: Licence policy for production dependencies (NFR-M07). Deny by default: a licence must be in 'allowed'. Licences matching 'blocked' can never be accepted, not even by an exception. 'exceptions' accept one package whose licence is not on the allow-list; each needs a reason. Checked by infra/ci/check-licenses.mjs (`pnpm licenses:check`).

elkjs.reason: EPL-2.0 (weak, file-level copyleft; not GPL/AGPL). Reaches the production tree only through the Prisma CLI (optional peer of @prisma/client), inside Prisma Studio's graph layout. Used unmodified and never launched by the product; EPL obligations apply only to modified EPL files. Added with P0-07; revisit if the Prisma CLI stops bundling Studio or the installer (P0-16) excludes it.

@img/sharp-libvips-linux-x64.reason: LGPL-3.0-or-later libvips, the image library behind sharp (P1-04 photo re-encoding, MENU-008, SEC-004). Shipped unmodified as a separate prebuilt shared library that sharp loads at run time, so LGPL obligations are met by keeping it replaceable and offering its source (the installer's third-party notices, P0-16). Only the package for the build platform is installed.
